name: Dancing Weapon (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 5, magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, F (a one-handed melee weapon)

Range touch

Target weapon touched

Duration 1 round/level

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

The touched weapon hovers around you and attacks nearby enemies. Once per round as a free action, the weapon can attack an adjacent creature you designate.

The weapon’s attack roll is equal to your caster level + your spellcasting ability modifier. The damage dealt by the weapon is its base damage plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Any enhancement bonuses or effects the weapon has apply to attack and damage as well.

This weapon cannot make attacks of opportunity and remains in your square. Like spiritual ally, this weapon does not gain any additional bonuses to attack or damage from positioning, your feats, class abilities, or actions.
